name: Riot Shield
summary: Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain +1 AC and advantage against being shoved.  Riot Shield; When you take the Dodge action with a shield, one adjacent ally also gains +2 AC.  Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks.  Riot Shield; While using a shield, you and one adjacent ally gain +1 to Dexterity saves.
descriptionMarkdown:
Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain +1 AC and advantage against being shoved.

Riot Shield; When you take the Dodge action with a shield, one adjacent ally also gains +2 AC.

Riot Shield; While using a shield, you gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks.

Riot Shield; While using a shield, you and one adjacent ally gain +1 to Dexterity saves.
